mapper.sql: select id, site_code, name, description, range_code, metrics, send_hour, receivers, enabled, ai_enabled, ai_model, snapshot_enabled, snapshot_filters, freq_type, freq_dow, freq_every, freq_to, view_gran, view_cmp, view_from, view_to, view_cmp_from, view_cmp_to, source_page, owner_user_id, last_slot, last_run_at, last_status, last_error, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from dashboard_subscription
mapper.select: where del_flag = '0' and upper(site_code) = upper(#{siteCode}) and enabled = #{enabled} order by site_code, id
where del_flag = '0' and enabled = true order by id
mapper.insert: insert into dashboard_subscription (site_code, name, description, range_code, metrics, send_hour, receivers, enabled, ai_enabled, ai_model, snapshot_enabled, snapshot_filters, freq_type, freq_dow, freq_every, freq_to, view_gran, view_cmp, view_from, view_to, view_cmp_from, view_cmp_to, source_page, owner_user_id, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) values (#{siteCode}, #{name}, #{description}, #{rangeCode}, #{metrics}, #{sendHour}, #{receivers}, #{enabled}, coalesce(#{aiEnabled}, false), #{aiModel}, coalesce(#{snapshotEnabled}, false), #{snapshotFilters}, coalesce(#{freqType}, 'DAY'), #{freqDow}, #{freqEvery}, #{freqTo}, #{viewGran}, coalesce(#{viewCmp}, 'PREV'), #{viewFrom}, #{viewTo}, #{viewCmpFrom}, #{viewCmpTo}, coalesce(#{sourcePage}, 'ov'), #{ownerUserId}, #{createBy}, localtimestamp, #{createBy}, localtimestamp)
mapper.update: update dashboard_subscription set name = #{name}, description = #{description}, range_code = #{rangeCode}, metrics = #{metrics}, send_hour = #{sendHour}, receivers = #{receivers}, enabled = #{enabled}, ai_enabled = coalesce(#{aiEnabled}, false), ai_model = #{aiModel}, snapshot_enabled = coalesce(#{snapshotEnabled}, false), snapshot_filters = #{snapshotFilters}, freq_type = coalesce(#{freqType}, 'DAY'), freq_dow = #{freqDow}, freq_every = #{freqEvery}, freq_to = #{freqTo}, view_gran = #{viewGran}, view_cmp = coalesce(#{viewCmp}, 'PREV'), view_from = #{viewFrom}, view_to = #{viewTo}, view_cmp_from = #{viewCmpFrom}, view_cmp_to = #{viewCmpTo}, owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = localtimestamp where id = #{id} and del_flag = '0'
update dashboard_subscription set enabled = #{enabled}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = localtimestamp where id = #{id} and del_flag = '0'
update dashboard_subscription set del_flag = '2', enabled = false, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = localtimestamp where id = #{id} and del_flag = '0'
update dashboard_subscription set last_slot = #{slot} where id = #{id} and del_flag = '0' and enabled = true and (last_slot is null or last_slot <> #{slot})
mapper.insert: insert into dashboard_subscription_log (subscription_id, site_code, trigger_type, period, receiver_type, receiver_id, receiver_name, status, error, message_id, operator, create_time, run_id, result, reason_code, attempts) values (#{subscriptionId}, #{siteCode}, #{triggerType}, #{period}, #{receiverType}, #{receiverId}, #{receiverName}, #{status}, #{error}, #{messageId}, #{operator}, localtimestamp, #{runId}, #{result}, #{reasonCode}, #{attempts})

insert into dashboard_subscription_run (subscription_id, site_code, trigger_type, plan_at, sent_at, period, compare_period, result, reason_code, error, receiver_total, sent, failed, ai_status, ai_error, snapshot_status, snapshot_error, operator, started_at, finished_at) values (#{subscriptionId}, #{siteCode}, #{triggerType}, #{planAt}, #{sentAt}, #{period}, #{comparePeriod}, coalesce(#{result}, 'RUNNING'), #{reasonCode}, #{error}, coalesce(#{receiverTotal}, 0), coalesce(#{sent}, 0), coalesce(#{failed}, 0), #{aiStatus}, #{aiError}, #{snapshotStatus}, #{snapshotError}, #{operator}, localtimestamp, case when coalesce(#{result}, 'RUNNING') = 'RUNNING' then null else localtimestamp end)
mapper.update: update dashboard_subscription_run set result = #{result}, reason_code = #{reasonCode}, error = #{error}, sent_at = #{sentAt}, period = #{period}, compare_period = #{comparePeriod}, receiver_total = coalesce(#{receiverTotal}, 0), sent = coalesce(#{sent}, 0), failed = coalesce(#{failed}, 0), ai_status = #{aiStatus}, ai_error = #{aiError}, snapshot_status = #{snapshotStatus}, snapshot_error = #{snapshotError}, finished_at = localtimestamp where id = #{id}
update dashboard_subscription_run set result = 'FAIL', error = '發送中斷', finished_at = localtimestamp where result = 'RUNNING' and started_at < localtimestamp - make_interval(mins => #{minutes})
mapper.select: select count(*) from dashboard_subscription_run where subscription_id = #{subscriptionId} and result = 'RUNNING' and started_at >= localtimestamp - make_interval(mins => #{minutes})

select distinct on (subscription_id) id, subscription_id, site_code, trigger_type, plan_at, sent_at, period, compare_period, result, reason_code, error, receiver_total, sent, failed, ai_status, ai_error, snapshot_status, snapshot_error, operator, started_at, finished_at from dashboard_subscription_run where upper(site_code) = upper(#{siteCode}) and result <> 'RUNNING' order by subscription_id, sent_at desc nulls last, id desc

select id, subscription_id, site_code, trigger_type, period, receiver_type, receiver_id, receiver_name, status, error, message_id, operator, create_time, run_id, result, reason_code, attempts from dashboard_subscription_log where run_id = #{runId} order by id

select l.id as log_id, l.run_id, r.subscription_id, s.name as subscription_name, (s.del_flag = '2') as deleted, r.trigger_type, r.operator, r.plan_at, r.sent_at, r.period, r.compare_period, l.receiver_id, l.receiver_name, l.result, l.reason_code, l.attempts
order by r.sent_at desc, r.subscription_id, l.id limit #{q.limit} offset #{q.offset}

select distinct on (l.receiver_id) l.receiver_id as "chatId", l.receiver_name as "name" from dashboard_subscription_log l join dashboard_subscription_run r on r.id = l.run_id where upper(r.site_code) = upper(#{siteCode}) order by l.receiver_id, l.id desc
select id as "id", name as "name", (del_flag = '2') as "deleted" from dashboard_subscription where upper(site_code) = upper(#{siteCode}) order by id
